sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/fort-wayne.json: read. Maps results were mostly residential bath remodelers, plumbers and stores. Only Interior Products Supply was relevant. The web results were Google redirect URLs, mostly directory pages.

ASI, Scranton, Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions and Ampco locators: not attempted separately because the search cap left no budget. CIH's partitions page names the Accurate, Bobrick, General Partitions, Bradley and Scranton brands.
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com search and iProView pages): blocked, 403
Procore network (network.procore.com/us/in/door-hardware and profiles): worked. It turned up IPS, Moss Building Products and In-Site Construction in Fort Wayne.
BBB partition categories (Fort Wayne, Fishers, Cromwell, statewide IN): worked, but they list mostly OH, MI and Indianapolis firms

One Point Partitions Fort Wayne page (fxstaging.onepointpartitions.com): blocked, 403. It is an online reseller and competitor with a Fort Wayne freight terminal and no confirmed install crews, so it was not included.

WebSearch: all 8 searches used ('toilet partition installation Fort Wayne', 'Division 10 Fort Wayne', 'Allied Installation Service', 'lockers + partitions NE Indiana', nearby cities, door hardware specialties, Division 10 doors Fort Wayne (extended), Warsaw/Kendallville/Auburn). They mostly returned plumbers and national sellers. No dedicated Fort Wayne partition installer turned up besides TI Source/In-Site.

Company sites read: ti-source.com, cih-inc.com, ipsfortwayne.com, mossbp.com, d10pro.com, indianawholesalesupply.com, kelleybros.com/locations, midwest-specialties.com. Midwest Specialties (Paragon, IN, about 150 miles away) was excluded as beyond 120 miles. ipsdoordivision.com returned 503.

Existing repo research (indianapolis, toledo, dayton, grand-rapids files): used to find regional candidates. The Michigan and Ohio firms (Zietlow, GLBS, Tanner Supply, Roberts Installation, Irwin Enterprises) were not included because none states it serves Indiana or Fort Wayne.

candidates.name: Kelley Bros (Indianapolis office)
candidates.partition_evidence: Division 10 page lists toilet partitions (Global, Scranton, Hadrian) and offers a turn-key solution from quote through installation.
red_flags: Large Division 8/10 distributor that sells partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Only Indiana office is Indianapolis (~110 miles); no Fort Wayne office
Installation may be subcontracted; confirm own crews
candidates.reason: Regional distributor-installer with an Indiana office that supplies and installs toilet partitions turn-key; Indiana is a listed service state. Strong on capability but it competes with us on supply.

license.name: Kelley Bros (Indianapolis office)
license.registry: Allen County Building Department contractor licensing (Accela Citizen Access, aca-prod.accela.com/ACFW); Indiana has no state contractor license for this work
license.note: Not looked up. The area rule says no local requirement, but the Allen County/Fort Wayne Accela portal lists a 'Building Department Account Access' licensing contact (449-7342, ACBDLicensing@allencounty.in.gov) and has a licensee search form. The portal says that from November 12, 2026 an account sign-in is required for any search, so it can't be checked automatically. Third-party guides (Procore, Jobber, Harbor Compliance; not official) say Allen County issues general, building and other contractor licenses that renew each year. Whether a partition or toilet accessory installer needs one is unconfirmed: check by phone with the Allen County Building Department. Indiana licenses only plumbing at state level, per secondary sources. Because the company is based in Indianapolis, Indianapolis DBNS contractor licensing may also apply to its home work. That was not checked.
